caption: The drawing features a detailed, monochromatic depiction of a chalice or goblet centered on a lightly yellowed rectangular sheet of paper. The goblet is rendered in shades of black and grey with fine stippling to show shading and form, and is symmetrical with a rounded bowl, a stem that narrows and then flares towards the base, and a wide, flat foot. In the upper left corner of the sheet, there is a smaller inset line drawing of the same goblet, annotated with dimensions “3 7/8”” in width and “7”” in height. The main goblet drawing occupies the central area of the page, and there are faint orange-brown stains near the top and lower left side of the paper. The drawing is bordered by a faint pencil rectangle, and the artist’s name, “Pallington Campbell,” is written in cursive in the lower right corner of the image area. The background is plain and uncolored except for natural discoloration from age.
title: Pewter Cup
